visible_face_coverage_controls_v1.scope: Synthetic depth-order controls for visible-face overlap. Does not certify LHM expected depth as a true physical surface or validate real image quality.

helmet_body_face_depth_aware_profile_v2.scope: Shared canonical level/tilt and side/back rim-drop family: fixed source closed hull,30step bounded smoothing and.001world-numerical-unit shell thickness prior; all8x300 native ROI labels plus visible nose/eye non-coverage evidence. Fixed input poses/body-depth for this geometry block. Full-body segmentation, proxy face visibility and source hull remain imperfect. Selected input score is not real cavity/contact/new-view truth. New UV, texture bake, pose/head refit and actual image comparisons required before adoption; baseline reconstruction is asserted exact. Nonplanar signed-field clipping lowers side/back rim relative to the plane without independently generating each frame. This is a low-dimensional opening-shape prior tested against observations, not measured cavity reconstruction. Plane metadata describes the base plane only; chosen side/back drops are explicit in selected. Surface clipping is linear on each source triangle. Face noncoverage uses frozen initial directional visibility from the stated avatar and semantic anchor identity, excluding hand uncertainty and back-camera hallucinations; still model-dependent screening. New closed source compared to the unchanged current-shell control under the SAME updated motion/visibility protocol; no exact-zero-rebuild claim for a different source hull. Bounded smoothing iterations explicitly recorded. Face-coverage selection now excludes helmet surfaces behind the human face: a point contributes only with reliable positive body depth and helmet depth in front by the recorded margin. Fixed body-depth-supported face denominator is independent of candidate coverage; missing body depth is unknown, not bare-depth fallback. Raw alpha projection is retained only as a diagnostic (or explicit legacy reproduction). LHM expected depth remains approximate and this is not physical contact certification.

depth_aware_profile_alternation_v2.scope: One geometry-to-pose-to-UV/native-texture block on a fixed shaped/face-constrained human. Actual identical-camera contacts require visual review. No adoption or full-goal completion.

helmet_depth_aware_profile_pose_v2.scope: All8 main experiment; every300 frame uses real SAM2 candidate masks. Proposed stable-grasp/head-relative phases share transforms with small bounded per-frame residuals; other intervals free.Coarse search skipped during warm-started shape/pose alternation, original calibrated cameras/fixed shared scale. Tri-state silhouette loss restores half-weight negative evidence only when the predicted object is >.01 normalized-world units in front of a conservative LHM expected-depth core, away from hands and boundaries. Model/mask/rotation ambiguity remains. Before/after use same current mask/depth protocol after coarse initialization, not prior masks or held-out evaluation. Saved canonical geometry from the stated initialization is reused; candidate geometry/material provenance is in its source reports. No physical-contact accuracy claim. Worn-phase per-frame axis limits divided by sqrt(3) bound the TOTAL residual rotation/translation norms by the specified values; shared phase transform is still optimized. This enforces an attachment prior, not measured contact or metric-unit accuracy. Tight bounds may expose frozen-head motion errors. Native-image helmet ROI observations mapped to256-square with explicit per-observation pixel-center affine K, preserving much more helmet silhouette detail than256-wide full-frame fitting. Body depth remains the existing coarse cache, conservatively resampled; no extra body-depth accuracy claimed. Before/after are THIS ROI protocol only, not directly comparable to full-frame IoU.
helmet_depth_aware_profile_pose_v2.body_occlusion_scope: Stated source avatar saved LHM rig, Gaussian appearance and neural decoder, no helmet clipping. Positive OpenCV Z is opacity-normalized expected Gaussian-center depth, NOT a nearest opaque surface or decoded geometric surface. Extra second-depth moment rejects mixtures with std>=.01 normalized-world units; accumulated and decoded alpha must both exceed.95, then one-pixel eroded. Excluded pixels remain unknown, no bare-depth fallback. Cache hand uncertainty comes unchanged from fitted bare-hand landmarks. Rendering at504x378 and explicit pixel-center K; nearest-exact resampling to existing256x192 cache convention. No metric-unit, correct-contact or novel-view quality claim.

color_correction.scope: Approximate affine response fit in assumed linearized sRGB, same-time surface correspondences, robust loss, fixed reference camera and bounded coefficients. Not spectral/colorimetric calibration or recovered albedo; clipping, pose error and view-dependent lighting remain. Exposure gain is shared acrossRGB with bounded±2EV, chromatic correction is limited to exp(±.15), and black-level bias is shared acrossRGB within±.01 assumed-linear units. This reduces artificial chroma in dark lining; it does not recover missing source detail or guarantee registration.

helmet_depth_aware_profile_texture_v2.scope: Real original native PNG multiframe/multicamera UV appearance, two best-angle observations per camera then channelwise weighted median across up to16 samples. Positive candidate labels, native mesh self-depth and surface-class agreement, conservative body depth and hand-unknown exclusion. Unobserved texels explicitly marked and repaired by nearby observed same-class colors or class medians/design fallbacks. Not calibrated albedo, relighting or proof of correct geometry/texture; pose/segmentation/lighting errors remain. Requires actual real/novel-view rendering and held-out evaluation. No raw footage/model weights published. Candidate frames first ranked by same-time corrected cross-camera color consistency, with explicit support/error gates. No stage or observed-dark-lining selection; common pose/color bias can still survive.

frame_consistency_selection.scope: Same-time corrected RGB disagreement on common visible candidate surface points, at least64 supported points. Top60percent passing.08 assumed-linear-RGB error gate, per surface class when requested; outer white surfaces must not decide lining visibility. Two-camera support is used for the separately scored cavity because the open hemisphere is seen by fewer cameras; pair agreement has weaker outlier rejection and cannot establish true geometry. No held/worn stage restriction or lining dark-pixel gate.

depth_aware_profile_input_comparison_v1.scope: Same calibrated8 input cameras and explicit pixel-center1008x756 rendering, Gaussian-center mesh culling and saved neural decoder. Candidate SAM person/accepted helmet masks define FIXED source-foreground RGB support and eroded11pixel SSIM interior; missing rendered foreground counts as RGB error. White target background used only to avoid raw background contamination in SSIM windows. Mask IoUs include predicted leaks, separate visible body/helmet masks; unknown helmet annotations skipped. No per-candidate exposure fitting or color gains applied, so camera-response/light differences remain. Sampled or all-frame scope explicit. Input-view diagnostics only, not independent novel-view truth or contact certification; original-derived private sheets must not be published.

correction: Historical face coverage in body_face_20261018.json and older geometry reports is RAW projected helmet alpha, not visible face occlusion. A rear helmet surface can project onto a visible face. Reproduce historical scoring with --legacy-raw-face-coverage. New default requires reliable body depth and a helmet surface in front; unsupported points remain unknown. Only 490/1309 selected points depth-supported here; zero measured front overlap does not prove absence elsewhere.
scope: One shared geometry/pose/UV/texture alternating block, fixed human. Three-frame eight-input-camera diagnostics and generated review only; gray texture patches persist. No final quality adoption, independent novel-view truth, or full-goal completion.
